title: Stock Market Today Live, Sept 10: Sensex, Nifty trades weak as crude oil surge, geopolitical tensions weigh on sentiment - The HinduBusinessLine
text:

Sensex Today, Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates - Find here all the live updates related to Sensex, Nifty, BSE, NSE, share prices and Indian stock markets for 10 September 2026.

Indian stocks trade flat in a listless noon session as elevated crude oil prices, rising US Treasury yields and persistent geopolitical tensions weigh on investor sentiment.

At 1.24 p.m., the Sensex was up 28.46 points, or 0.038 per cent, at 74,792.69, while the Nifty rose 10.35 points, or 0.044 per cent, to 23,441.85.

On Wednesday, the BSE Sensex tumbled 813.35 points, or 1.08 per cent, to 74,764.23, while the Nifty 50 declined 203.60 points, or 0.86 per cent, to 23,431.50.

WTI crude has climbed to $96–97 per barrel, while Brent is above $101.50, raising inflation concerns and pushing Treasury yields higher.

Asian markets are also weaker, with Japan’s Nikkei 225 and South Korea’s Kospi falling more than 1 per cent in early trade after losses on Wall Street and European markets.

Investors will closely watch upcoming US inflation data for clues on the Federal Reserve’s policy trajectory. A stronger-than-expected reading could reinforce higher-for-longer rate expectations.

The 23,400-23,300 zone will be crucial in determining whether the decline extends or bargain buying triggers a technical recovery. Escalating US-Iran hostilities and disruption to global oil supplies remain key risks.

* Trend: Bearish — the downtrend remains intact in Nifty 50 and September futures.

* Advance/decline ratio: 20/30 — breadth is negative, supporting the bearish bias.

* Immediate support: 23,500 in September futures. A break below this could trigger further selling.

* Immediate resistance: 23,600. Upside is likely to remain capped here unless there is a clear breakout.

* Higher resistance: 23,680, followed by 23,750.

* Futures price action: September futures opened below the previous close and remain around 23,530, despite the underlying Nifty opening higher — a sign of weakness.

* Sector breadth: Nifty Realty is the weakest sector, while PSU Bank is outperforming; this does not alter the broader bearish setup.

* Higher targets/resistances: 23,680–23,750

Dev Information Technology Ltd (DEVIT) has secured an enterprise technology order from the ‘Central Power Research Institute (CPRI) Bangalore,’ under the Ministry of Power, Government of India worth Rs. 30 Lakhs approximately

Chemkart India informed the appointment of Mohammad Asim Siddiqui as a Chief Financial Officer w.e.f. Sep 11, following the resignation of Basavaraj Shankar Dalawai.

Fino Paymets’ average total deposits in August 2026 stood at Rs 2,821 crore compared Rs 2509 crore in August 2025.

IndusInd shares traded at Rs 989.70 on the NSE, down 1%.

Gold Rate Today: Today's gold prices of 22, 24 carat up across metro cities on September 10

The SBI Chairman said banks are unlikely to deploy the surplus liquidity immediately, as the banking system had a ₹10.5 lakh crore surplus as of September 8.

The Vietnamese automaker is developing India-specific EVs, internally codenamed VF X and VF Y, as it seeks to cut costs and target the country’s growing affordable electric-car market.

MedPlus Health Services approved the acquisition of the residual stake i.e. 0.01% of the total shareholding of Optival Health Solutions Private Limited, a material subsidiary of the Company, from the remaining shareholders.

Sonaselection India Limited, an integrated fabric manufacturing and processing company engaged in the production of value-added products, has announced the launch of its Initial Public Offering (”IPO”), scheduled to open on Thursday, September 17, 2026, and close on Monday, September 21, 2026. The Anchor Investor Bid/Issue Period will open on Wednesday, September 16, 2026, one working day before the issue opening.

The Initial Public Offering comprises a Fresh Issue of up to 14,300,000 equity shares, with a face value of ₹10 each.

Hinduja Global Solutions flat at Rs 385.25 on the NSE. Subsidiary IndusInd Media & Communications approved sale of entire 51% stake in Bhima Riddhi Infotainment.

NSE IPO: Top shareholders trim stake sales as investors expect higher post-listing valuation

JK Paper shares up 1.5% to Rs 415.15 on the NSE following the acquisition of the remaining 20% stake in Radhesham Wellpack for Rs 44 cr

IRB Infrastructure Developers traded 3% higher at Rs 19.61 on the NSE, hitting a high of Rs 20.60 from Rs 19.07 previous close. August toll revenue rose 25% YoY to Rs 807 cr

Coal India shares flat at Rs 433.45 on the NSE; Subsidiary Northern Coalfields reported a 67% rise in coal production and a 75% increase in dispatches as of Sep’26

Wipro shares flat at Rs 166.42 on the NSE. It had launched a CISO Command Centre in collaboration with CrowdStrike to strengthen enterprise cybersecurity operations

Gujarat Ambuja Exports traded flat at Rs 166.77 on the NSE. Company plans to invest Rs 333 cr in an 850-TPD greenfield corn wet milling unit at Hubli

BSE experienced outage for a brief period from 9:42 am, affecting one of the partitions in the cash segment affecting the scrips that are mapped to it, while all other partitions operated normally. The issue was resolved, and normal operations resumed at 10:08 a.m.

PC Jeweller has cleared and repaid all outstanding debt to one more bank under the Settlement Agreement dated September 30, 2024. With this, the company has repaid all outstanding debt to 11 of its 14 consortium banks, with all repayments completed ahead of scheduled due dates. It has also discharged more than 96 per cent of the outstanding debt of the remaining three banks and said it remains on track to repay the remaining less than 4 per cent and achieve debt-free status in the current month.
